source_processing: Sequencing reads were demultiplexed and aligned to the human reference genome using the CellRanger Pipeline v5

Unfiltered RNA UMI counts were loaded into Seurat v4.0.1 (Stuart et al., 2019) for quality control, data integration and downstream analyses. Apoptotic cells and empty sequencing capsules were excluded by filtering out cells with fewer than 500 features or a mitochondrial content higher than 20%.
Data from each sample were SCT normalisedand scaled, before batch correction using Seurat’s FindIntegratedAnchors.

To evaluate the expression of the 11 surface protein, the antibody-derived tags (ADT) counts for the cells retained after filtering were loaded in the integrated seurat object and normalised using the CLR normalisation method.
BCR reads were aligned to the GRCh38 reference genome (vdj_GRCh38_alts_ensembl-5.0.0) and consensus BCR annotation was performed using the cellranger vdj program (v5.0.1)

title: JT1, GEX
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated blood from five PAPS patients and two HD. Total B cells were isolated with the EasySep™ Human B-cell Isolation Kit (Stemcell Technologies). B cells were resuspended at 10x106/mL and incubated with Human TruStain FcX Fc Blocking reagent for 10min at 4°C. Cells were then incubated with the 10 following antibodies conjugated to an antibody-derived tag for 30 min at 4°C : CD19 (HIB19,TotalSeq, BioLegend) CD27 (0323), CD24 (ML5), CD38 (HIT2), CD5 (UCHT2), HLA-DR (L243), CD86 (IT2.2), IgM (MHM-88), IgD (IA6-2), CD21 (Bu32).

The scRNA-seq libraries were generated using Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’ V(D)J Reagent Kit v.1.1 with Feature Barcoding (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Gene expression (mRNA), ADT and VDJ BCR libraries were constructed. Briefly, cells were counted and up to 10 000 cells were loaded in the 10X Genomics Chromium Controller to generate single-cell gel-beads in emulsion. After reverse transcription, gel-beads in emulsion were disrupted. Barcoded complementary DNA was isolated and amplified by PCR. Following fragmentation, end repair and A-tailing, sample indexes were added during index PCR. The purified libraries were sequenced on a Novaseq S2 flowcell (Illumina).

title: BL18, GEX
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated blood from five PAPS patients and two HD. Total B cells were isolated with the EasySep™ Human B-cell Isolation Kit (Stemcell Technologies). B cells were resuspended at 10x106/mL and incubated with Human TruStain FcX Fc Blocking reagent for 10min at 4°C. Cells were then incubated with the 10 following antibodies conjugated to an antibody-derived tag for 30 min at 4°C : CD19 (HIB19,TotalSeq, BioLegend) CD27 (0323), CD24 (ML5), CD38 (HIT2), CD5 (UCHT2), HLA-DR (L243), CD86 (IT2.2), IgM (MHM-88), IgD (IA6-2), CD21 (Bu32).

The scRNA-seq libraries were generated using Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’ V(D)J Reagent Kit v.1.1 with Feature Barcoding (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Gene expression (mRNA), ADT and VDJ BCR libraries were constructed. Briefly, cells were counted and up to 10 000 cells were loaded in the 10X Genomics Chromium Controller to generate single-cell gel-beads in emulsion. After reverse transcription, gel-beads in emulsion were disrupted. Barcoded complementary DNA was isolated and amplified by PCR. Following fragmentation, end repair and A-tailing, sample indexes were added during index PCR. The purified libraries were sequenced on a Novaseq S2 flowcell (Illumina).
data_processing: Sequencing reads were demultiplexed and aligned to the human reference genome using the CellRanger Pipeline v8

Unfiltered RNA UMI counts were loaded into Seurat v4.0.1 (Stuart et al., 2019) for quality control, data integration and downstream analyses. Apoptotic cells and empty sequencing capsules were excluded by filtering out cells with fewer than 500 features or a mitochondrial content higher than 20%.
Data from each sample were SCT normalisedand scaled, before batch correction using Seurat’s FindIntegratedAnchors.

To evaluate the expression of the 11 surface protein, the antibody-derived tags (ADT) counts for the cells retained after filtering were loaded in the integrated seurat object and normalised using the CLR normalisation method.
BCR reads were aligned to the GRCh38 reference genome (vdj_GRCh38_alts_ensembl-5.0.0) and consensus BCR annotation was performed using the cellranger vdj program (v8.0.0)
Assembly: GRCh38-2020-A and vdj_GRCh38_alts_ensembl-5.0.0

Cells were then incubated with the 10 following antibodies conjugated to an antibody-derived tag for 30 min at 4°C : CD19 (HIB19,TotalSeq, BioLegend) CD27 (0323), CD24 (ML5), CD38 (HIT2), CD5 (UCHT2), HLA-DR (L243), CD86 (IT2.2), IgM (MHM-88), IgD (IA6-2), CD21 (Bu32).

The scRNA-seq libraries were generated using Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’ V(D)J Reagent Kit v.1.1 with Feature Barcoding (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Gene expression (mRNA), ADT and VDJ BCR libraries were constructed. Briefly, cells were counted and up to 10 000 cells were loaded in the 10X Genomics Chromium Controller to generate single-cell gel-beads in emulsion. After reverse transcription, gel-beads in emulsion were disrupted. Barcoded complementary DNA was isolated and amplified by PCR. Following fragmentation, end repair and A-tailing, sample indexes were added during index PCR. The purified libraries were sequenced on a Novaseq S2 flowcell (Illumina).
data_processing: Sequencing reads were demultiplexed and aligned to the human reference genome using the CellRanger Pipeline v8

Unfiltered RNA UMI counts were loaded into Seurat v4.0.1 (Stuart et al., 2019) for quality control, data integration and downstream analyses. Apoptotic cells and empty sequencing capsules were excluded by filtering out cells with fewer than 500 features or a mitochondrial content higher than 20%.
Data from each sample were SCT normalisedand scaled, before batch correction using Seurat’s FindIntegratedAnchors.

To evaluate the expression of the 11 surface protein, the antibody-derived tags (ADT) counts for the cells retained after filtering were loaded in the integrated seurat object and normalised using the CLR normalisation method.
BCR reads were aligned to the GRCh38 reference genome (vdj_GRCh38_alts_ensembl-5.0.0) and consensus BCR annotation was performed using the cellranger vdj program (v8.0.0)
Assembly: GRCh38-2020-A and vdj_GRCh38_alts_ensembl-5.0.0
Supplementary files format and content: h5 files contain the raw count matrix for each sample
Supplementary files format and content: the rds file contains the Seurat object of all integrated samples
Library strategy: CITE-Seq
